name: Bench Dips Single-Leg with Plate
description: Bench dips performed with one leg raised while a weight plate sits on the thigh, adding resistance without bilateral loading. The single-leg variation adds core stabilization demands. This is an accessible way to progressively overload bench dips.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Bench Dips Single-Leg with Plate in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Bench Dips Single-Leg with Plate.
steps: Step 1: Sit on bench edge with hands behind hips. Place plate on one thigh.
Step 2: Slide hips off bench and raise the weighted leg slightly.
Step 3: Lower body by bending elbows, maintaining balance.
Step 4: Press back to full extension using tricep strength.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Hips stay close to bench edge
Keep weighted leg parallel to floor
